definitions.explanation: A weather term used in Japan for days when the maximum temperature reaches 35°C (95°F) or higher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猛暑日|もうしょび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧だ。
examples.english: The forecast says today will be an extremely hot day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猛暑日|もうしょび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This summer had many extremely hot days.

examples.japanese: {猛暑日|もうしょび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: On extremely hot days, you need to be careful of heatstroke.

notes:
{猛暑日|もうしょび} is an official ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧ (Japan Meteorological Agency) term for a day when the maximum temperature reaches 35°C or higher.

TEMPERATURE SCALE IN JAPAN:
- {夏日|なつび}: over 25°C (summer day)
- ⟦{真夏日|まなつび}→真夏日：10186_manatsubi⟧: over 30°C (midsummer day)
- {猛暑日|もうしょび}: over 35°C (extremely hot day)
- {酷暑日|こくしょび}: over 40°C (newer unofficial term)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧: extreme heat, heat wave (the general condition)
- ⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧: heatstroke
- {暑|しょ}さ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: heat countermeasures

USAGE:
Frequently appears in weather forecasts and news during summer. Often used alongside ⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧ warnings. The term was officially adopted in 2007 as summer temperatures in Japan continued to rise.
